description: Hydropathy, lipobox and SPase I cleavage-site analysis of PstS P0AG82 to test for a membrane anchor in the mature protein
code:
import requests, re, json
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fa = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P0AG82.fasta", timeout=60).text
seq = "".join(fa.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
print("header:", fa.split("\n")[0])
print("length:", len(seq))
print("full sequence:")
for i in range(0, len(seq), 60):
    print(f"{i+1:>4} {seq[i:i+60]}")

sp = seq[:25]; mat = seq[25:]
print("\nPredicted signal peptide (1-25):", sp)
print("Mature N-terminus (26-37):", seq[25:37])
print("Mature length:", len(mat))

# --- Signal peptide architecture: n-region / h-region / c-region ---
pos = sum(sp[:8].count(x) for x in "KR")
neg = sum(sp[:8].count(x) for x in "DE")
print(f"\nn-region (1-8) '{sp[:8]}': +charged={pos}, -charged={neg}, net={pos-neg}")

# Kyte-Doolittle scale
KD = {'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,
      'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,
      'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
kd = np.array([KD[a] for a in seq])
def smooth(x, w):
    k = np.ones(w)/w
    return np.convolve(x, k, mode='same')
kd19 = smooth(kd, 19)   # classic TM window
kd9  = smooth(kd, 9)

print("\nMax KD(window=19) over MATURE region 26-346:", round(kd19[25:].max(),3),
      "at residue", int(np.argmax(kd19[25:]))+26)
print("Max KD(window=19) over SIGNAL region 1-25:", round(kd19[:25].max(),3),
      "at residue", int(np.argmax(kd19[:25]))+1)
print("Residues in mature region with KD19 > 1.6 (TM threshold):",
      int((kd19[25:] > 1.6).sum()))
print("Longest run of KD9 > 1.6 in mature region:",)
runs=[];c=0
for v in kd9[25:]:
    c = c+1 if v>1.6 else 0
    runs.append(c)
print("  ", max(runs) if runs else 0, "residues (need ~>=17-19 for a TM helix)")

# --- Lipobox check (SPase II / lipoprotein anchor) ---
print("\n--- Lipoprotein (lipobox) check ---")
print("Residue 26 (mature N-term, would be +1 Cys if lipoprotein):", seq[25])
print("Residues 21-30:", seq[20:30])
lipobox = re.compile(r'[LVIAMFGT][^DERK][GASNL][C]')
hits = [(m.start()+1, m.group()) for m in lipobox.finditer(seq[:40])]
print("Lipobox-like [LVIAMFGT]-X-[GAS]-C matches in first 40 aa:", hits if hits else "NONE")
print("Cysteines in whole protein at positions:", [i+1 for i,a in enumerate(seq) if a=='C'] or "NONE")

# --- SPase I (-3,-1) rule at the annotated site ---
print("\n--- SPase I AXA (-3,-1) rule at annotated cleavage site 25/26 ---")
print("  -3 =", seq[22], " -2 =", seq[23], " -1 =", seq[24], " | +1 =", seq[25])
print("  AXA-type small residues at -3/-1?", seq[22] in "AGSVTC" and seq[24] in "AGSVTC")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4))
ax.plot(np.arange(1,len(seq)+1), kd19, lw=1.2, color="#2b6cb0")
ax.axhline(1.6, color="#c53030", ls="--", lw=1, label="TM helix threshold (KD 1.6)")
ax.axhline(0, color="grey", lw=0.6)
ax.axvspan(1, 25, color="#f6ad55", alpha=0.45, label="Annotated signal peptide 1-25")
ax.set_xlabel("Residue position in P0AG82 precursor")
ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy (window 19)")
ax.set_title("PstS (P0AG82): the only hydrophobic peak is the cleaved N-terminal signal peptide")
ax.legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(1, len(seq))
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
